units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:6">Yoma V, 6</cite> <he>על טָהֳרוֹ של מזבח</he> (or <he>טְהָרוֹ</he>) immediately on the top of the golden altar (free from coals or ashes, v. <cite ref="C00730"><he>גִּילּוּיָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Menachot 97a:11">Men. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>על טהרו של שולחן</he> (Ms. M. <he>על השל׳</he>) immediately on the golden table.

Yoma 59ᵃ (one opinion explain. טהרו של מזבח, v. supra) פלגיה דמזבח the centre of the altar front, as people say, טהר טיהרא והוי פלגא דיומא ‘the noon-light shines’ meaning by tihara the middle of the day; ib. 15ᵃ; Zeb. 38ᵇ
